actionability.justification: The rule tells the agent exactly what to do (implement only the requested scope) and what to do instead of over-delivering (ask before adding rewrites/extras), which is a concrete, checkable behavioral change.

generality_without_vagueness.justification: It covers the whole failure class (rewrites, refactors, extra unrequested artifacts) via concrete examples rather than a single narrow case, while staying short of an empty platitude like 'be careful with scope.'

leakage.justification: The remedy text is fully generic (no mention of specific files, UIs, or incidents from the evidence quotes) and would read naturally in any project's CLAUDE.md.

routing_fitness.justification: This is a judgment-call discipline issue that a hook can't mechanically verify and doesn't need a multi-step skill procedure, so a short standing claude-md rule is the cheapest adequate remedy, and the proposal correctly treats it as a revision of the pre-existing overlapping R5 rather than a duplicate addition.
